read.thesis: Supply-side tightening: ASML is looking to lift 2028 capacity above the 30% target, with FY26 sales guided to €44-45B (+36%) and pricing up for critical products from 2027.

capex.quote: we now anticipate that our current planned levels of output in 2027 and 2028 will not fully meet the demand of our customers

triggers.label: Price increases on critical products
triggers.quote: we have pricing increases for what we call the most critical products
triggers.highlight: pricing increases for what we call the most critical products

triggers.label: Low-NA EUV output ~65 systems 2026
triggers.quote: anticipate output of roughly 65 systems for 2026, which is nearly 50% more than the 44 systems

triggers.label: FY26 sales €44-45B (+36%)
triggers.quote: we expect our full year 2026 total net sales to be between €44 billion and €45 billion

triggers.label: Demand exceeds supply through 2028
triggers.quote: demand for their product will outpace supply through at least 2028
triggers.highlight: demand for their product will outpace supply through at least 2028

guidance.quote: we expect our full year 2026 total net sales to be between €44 billion and €45 billion
We expect Q4 total net sales to be between €14.2 billion and €15.2 billion with a gross margin of around 57%
we expect our full year 2026 total net sales to be between €44 billion and €45 billion with a gross margin of around 56%
We expect the China region to account for around 20% of our total net sales this year.

prior_guidance_check.metric: 2027 capacity growth 30% (low-NA EUV and DUV immersion)
prior_guidance_check.quote: we shared our intent last quarter to increase our capacity in 2027 by 30% for both low-NA EUV and DUV immersion systems

red_flags.label: Ramp costs compress Q4 gross margin

the only hesitation we have at this stage is that we really want to do our homework
